verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items in one operation is that users can ask for several scenarios at once in a single line (a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case). Re-importing past months and CSV row ingestion are bulk-ish data imports rather than bulk operations on Model items. Nothing documents bulk editing, deleting or updating many Pages, tables, formulas or Variables at once, through the UI or the MCP tools. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/update across many Model items, batch operations via MCP tools, limits or scale details for bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
